messages.subject: [NMOF-news] NMOF 0.39-0 released
messages.body_plain:
Version 0.39-0 of the NMOF package is available from
http://enricoschumann.net/R/packages/NMOF/index.htm

If you use GitHub, you can get the source also from
https://github.com/enricoschumann/NMOF

The NEWS file entry:

v0.39-0  (2016-09-30)

  o new function 'xtContractValue', for computing
    contract values of Australian government-bond
    futures


-- 
Enrico Schumann
Lucerne, Switzerland
http://enricoschumann.net

messages.subject: [NMOF-news] NMOF 0.40-0 released, also on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

version 0.40-0 of the NMOF package is now available
from http://enricoschumann.net/R/packages/NMOF/index.htm

It is also available from CRAN -- the release happened
5 years (exactly) after its first release on
CRAN. [1][2]

The NEWS file entry:

v0.40-0  (2016-10-20)

  o new function 'xtTickValue', which computes the tick
    value for of Australian government-bond futures



[1] https://stat.ethz.ch/pipermail/r-packages/2011/001257.html
[2] https://stat.ethz.ch/pipermail/r-packages/2016/001510.html


-- 
Enrico Schumann
Lucerne, Switzerland
http://enricoschumann.net
